summary: Created the appworker account on node1 and set login-session resource limits to 8192 open files and 256 processes via /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf; verified with a real login shell, then restarted node1 and confirmed persistence and recovery.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS (RHEL 7.9) and confirmed appworker did not exist
Created appworker account with useradd -m via sudo
Wrote /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf with soft/hard nofile=8192 and soft/hard nproc=256
Confirmed 90-appworker.conf sorts after the pre-existing 20-nproc.conf wildcard rule so it takes precedence
Verified limits via 'su - appworker' ulimit -n / ulimit -u = 8192 / 256
Captured baseline boot_id and account/limit state on node1
Issued a background 'shutdown -r now' so the acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until SSH/exec access returned
Confirmed changed boot_id proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified appworker account, limits file, and live ulimit values post-restart

evidence.summary: id appworker showed 'no such user' before creation; useradd via sudo succeeded producing uid=1001(appworker)

evidence.requirement: Login sessions limited to 8192 open files and 256 processes
evidence.summary: Wrote 90-appworker.conf with nofile/nproc limits, confirmed it sorts after the system-wide 20-nproc.conf so it wins, and a real 'su - appworker' shell reported ulimit -n=8192 and ulimit -u=256
Captured baseline boot_id fe422859-bfe7-4eb4-819b-e09864f3ca60 plus confirmed appworker account and limits file present before restart

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'shutdown -r now' via sudo; command returned 'reboot_issued' immediately

evidence.requirement: Node1 boot identity changed (proof of actual restart)
evidence.summary: Node was unreachable mid-reboot (connection timed out), then came back with new boot_id f8410ed7-450d-4263-b45a-6d2a28536ea3, differing from the pre-restart baseline

evidence.requirement: Node1 post-restart recovery of account and required limits
evidence.summary: After restart, getent passwd appworker still resolves, 90-appworker.conf persisted, and a live 'su - appworker' shell again reported ulimit -n=8192 and ulimit -u=256
